summary: Verified all 3 fixes: (1) slugify — 'Serial No.'→'serial_no', 'In stock'→'in_stock', 'Price ($)'→'price' in Fields dialog; 'Sales Orders'→'sales_orders', 'Prices ($)'→'prices', '2024 Model'→'f2024_model' in Entity Types dialog. Both pages import slugifyKey from @/lib/slugify (no local slugify remains). (2) Tooltip — hovering google-signin-wrap on /login and google-register-wrap on /register both show tooltip containing 'Google Sign-In not configured for this environment' immediately (delayDuration=0). (3) jti bonus — two consecutive POST /api/auth/login for owner return different access_token strings with different jti payload claims; same holds for consecutive /api/auth/refresh calls. Full Phase 1 regression suite still 32/32 green.
critical_code_review_comments: slugify policy for digit-leading strings prefixes 'f' (e.g. '2024 Model' → 'f2024_model'). Confirmed intentional in header comment. Alternative that some teams prefer: reject on UI with inline hint ('key cannot start with a digit') so the user renames the label deliberately. Current auto-prefix is silent — a user may not notice the key became 'f2024_model'. Non-blocking; ship as is unless product wants louder UX.

Tooltip content is announced twice by screen readers because Radix renders both the visible tooltip and an sr-only aria-describedby copy. Not a bug per se, but if you want a single announcement consider setting aria-label on the wrapper and hiding the tooltip from AT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 is fully green. slugify util at /app/frontend/src/lib/slugify.js is the single source of truth used by FieldsPage and EntityTypesPage. jti is in access-token payload (secrets.token_urlsafe(12)). Google OAuth remains env-gated (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=REPLACE_ME) and the disabled button shows tooltip on hover on both /login and /register.
